title: Operator identification
risk: Operator is not identified
prompt: Is the operator named: full legal entity or sole proprietor name, registration number, address, contact for legally significant notices? Are there unfilled placeholder fields where these details should be?
output_if_found: Name the operator with registration details and a notice address.

title: Acceptance of terms
risk: Acceptance procedure is not defined
prompt: How does the user accept the terms (click, wallet connection, use)? Are the document version and date and the moment of contract formation stated? If the document calls itself an offer, does it contain the essential terms and an acceptance procedure under the applicable law (see jurisdiction_rules)?
output_if_found: Describe the method and moment of acceptance and record the version of the terms.

title: Age and legal capacity
risk: Age and legal capacity are not specified
prompt: Is there a minimum age and a legal capacity requirement? Is the representative's authority required when a legal entity agrees?
output_if_found: Add age, capacity and authority requirements.

title: Sanctions and geography
risk: No sanctions or geographic restrictions
prompt: Are prohibited jurisdictions and sanctions lists stated? Does the ban on circumvention (VPN) match the actual measures? If a restriction is declared, is it backed by checks?
output_if_found: Add the list of restrictions and how they are applied.

title: Custody model vs mechanics
risk: Declared custody model does not match the mechanics
prompt: Which model is declared (custodial / non-custodial)? Compare with the mechanics: who holds the signing keys, are there pools or operational wallets controlled by the operator, can the operator move assets without the user's signature?
output_if_found: Align the statement with the mechanics: fix the wording or disclose the custodial model, its risks and regulatory status.

title: Responsibility for keys
risk: Responsibility for keys does not match the model
prompt: Is the user made responsible for keys and the seed phrase where the operator actually controls the keys?
output_if_found: Allocate responsibility for keys according to the real model.

title: Withdrawal right
risk: Right to withdraw is undercut by exceptions
prompt: Is the right to withdraw funds guaranteed? What delay and suspension conditions exist (liquidity, maintenance, 'at its discretion')? Are they consistent with the statement of the user's full control over assets?
output_if_found: Limit the grounds and duration of delays and describe the withdrawal procedure during suspension.

title: Blocking and freezing
risk: Blocking and freezing without grounds or notice
prompt: Are the grounds for blocking an account or funds, the duty to notify, the term and the appeal procedure stated?
output_if_found: Describe the grounds, notice and appeal procedure.

title: Risk disclosure
risk: Risk disclaimers are generic or absent
prompt: Are specific risks disclosed: volatility, smart contract vulnerabilities, forks, MEV and frontrunning, oracles, key loss, third-party protocol risks? Or only a generic phrase?
output_if_found: Add a section with specific risks applicable to the product.

title: Disclaimer of warranties (as is)
risk: No disclaimer of warranties (as is)
prompt: Is there an 'as is / as available' provision and a disclaimer of implied warranties? Is the inalienability of mandatory rights preserved?
output_if_found: Add a standard disclaimer of warranties with a mandatory-law carve-out.

title: Limitation of liability
risk: Limitation of liability is missing, unfilled or bypassed by exceptions
prompt: Is there a liability cap (amount, period)? Are the values filled in? Do exceptions ('except where liability cannot lawfully be excluded', 'except as...') nullify the stated cap in every case?
output_if_found: Set a cap and a clear list of exceptions.

title: Liability norm
risk: Liability refers to law instead of a norm
prompt: Are there specific provisions on liability? Consider the whole document. A general reference to applicable law is not an absent norm
output_if_found: Replace the reference with specific provisions.

title: User indemnity
risk: User indemnity without limits
prompt: Is the user obliged to indemnify the operator? Is the range of cases limited, does it cover only the user's own breaches?
output_if_found: Narrow and specify the indemnity obligation.

title: Third-party services
risk: Responsibility for third-party services is not defined
prompt: Does it state that the operator is not responsible for protocols, validators and providers? Is this consistent with the statement that the operator itself runs part of the infrastructure?
output_if_found: Separate own infrastructure from third-party services.

title: Investment service vs no advice
risk: Product resembles an investment service despite a 'no advice' statement
prompt: Does the document use wording such as 'investment strategies', 'yield', 'asset management'? Is there a 'not investment advice' provision and do they contradict each other?
output_if_found: Align the product wording and the advice disclaimer and assess the regulatory status.

title: Yield as estimate
risk: Yield is promised or not stated as an estimate
prompt: Is yield stated as a forecast and not guaranteed? Does it depend on external protocols?
output_if_found: State that rates are indicative and not guaranteed.

title: Operator regulatory status
risk: Operator's regulatory status is not disclosed or is negative
prompt: Are the operator and its regulatory status stated? Distinguish the governing law of the contract from the operator's jurisdiction
output_if_found: Disclose the status and its consequences for the user.

title: AML/KYC
risk: AML/KYC is not described or is outside the document
prompt: Are checks (KYC/AML) and the operator's right to request data described? If the policy is a separate document, is it attached?
output_if_found: Describe the procedures or attach the policy.

title: Taxes
risk: Taxes are not addressed
prompt: Is it defined who is responsible for the user's taxes and whether the operator withholds anything?
output_if_found: Add a provision on tax responsibility.

title: Fees
risk: Fees are not disclosed or change without a procedure
prompt: Are fees disclosed before the transaction is confirmed? Do not require fixed tariffs where calculation is dynamic
output_if_found: Disclose the fee structure and how it may change.

title: Unilateral amendments
risk: Unilateral changes to the terms without notice
prompt: Can the operator change the terms? From when, how are users notified, is there a right to refuse and exit?
output_if_found: Introduce a notice period and a right to refuse before the changes take effect.

title: Termination and suspension
risk: Termination and suspension without procedure or consequences for assets
prompt: Are the grounds for ending access and what happens to the user's assets afterwards stated?
output_if_found: Describe the grounds, procedure and return of assets.

title: Shutdown of the product
risk: Product shutdown without an asset return plan
prompt: May the operator discontinue the platform? How and by when are assets returned?
output_if_found: Describe the procedure for withdrawing assets on shutdown.

title: Governing law
risk: Governing law is not defined
prompt: Is the law stated, and does the choice conflict with the operator's location and mandatory consumer rules?
output_if_found: State the governing law.

title: Dispute resolution
risk: Dispute resolution procedure is not defined
prompt: Is the forum stated (court or arbitration, seat, language)? Is it consistent with the chosen law? Is the wording merely optional ('may seek relief')?
output_if_found: Define the forum and the procedure for claims.

title: Class action waiver and arbitration
risk: Class action waiver and arbitration without an opt-out
prompt: Is there a class action waiver or mandatory arbitration? Is there a right to opt out?
output_if_found: Assess admissibility in the user's jurisdiction and add an opt-out.

title: Consumer rights
risk: No clause on consumer rights
prompt: Is there a clause that the terms do not limit mandatory consumer rights?
output_if_found: Add a clause on mandatory rights.

title: Personal data
risk: Personal data is not addressed
prompt: Is there a link to a privacy policy? Are purposes, retention periods and cross-border transfers stated?
output_if_found: Add a link and a section on data.

title: Rights and license
risk: Rights and license are not defined
prompt: Are the operator's rights and the user's license defined? Are open source licenses taken into account?
output_if_found: Describe the rights and the scope of the license.

title: Unfilled fields
risk: Unfilled fields remain in the document
prompt: Is there a placeholder such as [..] or 'TBD' in the text? Checked by code.
output_if_found: Fill in the fields or remove the related provisions.

title: Referenced documents
risk: Document refers to documents that are not available
prompt: Is the text of the referenced documents (policies, appendices) provided? If not, status is insufficient_data.
output_if_found: Attach the documents or state them separately.

title: Definitions
risk: Terms are defined and used inconsistently
prompt: Are there direct contradictions between definitions and the use of terms?
output_if_found: Bring the terms to a single meaning.

title: General provisions
risk: No general provisions
prompt: Are there provisions on severability, entire agreement, language and assignment?
output_if_found: Add general provisions.
